category.title: ActionScript 3
category.description: Tracked families of language features and Flash APIs. The completed share of this registry is not a percentage of Flash Player compatibility.

features.title: Source diagnostics
features.scope: Parse errors and unsupported frontend constructs report the language, line and column; compilation errors block export.
features.limitations: This guarantees compiler diagnostics, not verification of every Flash API semantic.

features.title: Literals
features.scope: Decimal, hexadecimal and exponent numbers; strings; Boolean, null, undefined, NaN and Infinity; arrays without holes and object literals.
features.limitations: The full set of literals and historical Flash rules is not implemented; legacy numbers with leading zeroes are rejected.

features.title: Variables and scope
features.scope: var, multiple declarations, handler-owner fields, and hoisting of local var declarations and parameters.
features.limitations: Handler fields differ from classes and the full Flash scope chain; top-level declarations follow documented reinitialization rules.

features.title: Arithmetic, logic and assignments
features.scope: Basic arithmetic, comparisons, short-circuit evaluation, bitwise operations, ++/-- and compound assignments.
features.limitations: Some operations use JavaScript coercion; this is not complete AVM semantics across all Flash Player versions.

features.title: If/else branches
features.scope: Parsing and execution of if/else, blocks and the conditional expression ?:, selecting one branch.
features.limitations: This covers control flow in the supported frontend; conversion of arbitrary Flash objects remains part of unfinished type compatibility.

features.title: Classic loops and jumps
features.scope: while, do/while, three-part for, and nested break/continue with jump-target validation.
features.limitations: for..in property enumeration and full compatibility of condition coercion are tracked separately. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: Switch and fallthrough
features.scope: Single evaluation of the subject, sequential case matching, default, fallthrough and break.
features.limitations: The supported contract uses strict comparison; compatibility across Flash Player versions is not certified.

features.title: Function declarations and calls
features.scope: Function declarations/expressions, recursion, return, callbacks and immediate invocation; project declared methods have stable bound identity and can be shared across resolved source units.
features.limitations: The supported handler/project profiles do not implement unrestricted dynamic lookup, defaults/rest/arguments or complete Flash method semantics.

features.title: Closures and variable capture
features.scope: Lexical local variables, shadowing, closures retained after return, and capture of the handler owner.
features.limitations: The complete Flash receiver, global-object and scope-chain models are not implemented.

features.title: Function parameters and returns
features.scope: Positional parameters, exact argument counts, selected typed arguments/returns and return-path validation.
features.limitations: Default/rest parameters, arguments and general Function.call/apply are absent; full compatibility of types and invocation errors is unproven.

features.title: this and method binding
features.scope: Handler-level declared methods retain the handler owner when detached. Project declared methods retain stable bound instance/static receivers; explicit super method calls use the current instance.
features.limitations: General nested/expression-function receiver/global semantics remain incomplete; accessors and the complete Flash object model are not implemented.

features.title: Annotations and type system
features.scope: Selected primitive/Error defaults and coercions for handler bindings, arguments and returns; resolved project-class/native facade types; project class slot descriptors enforce supported defaults, writes and const protection across aliases. Resolved project interfaces support nominal typed fields/arguments/returns/casts; accessor arguments and returns use the existing coercion profile.
features.limitations: No complete AS3 type checker/VM. Old handler var declarations still do not create globally enforced class slots. Typed member assignment-expression results, complete host ownership/type rules and initialization conformance remain pending. The interfaces-accessors ordinary-export/real-WASM component scenario and representative browser model updates/Restart passed; unobserved contract paths remain separate, and no full AVM2 conformance is claimed.

features.title: Throw, catch and finally
features.scope: Throw, ordered catches for selected types, separate catch scopes, finally and abrupt-completion precedence.
features.limitations: Catches for arbitrary classes/interfaces, boxed-primitive equivalence and complete AVM2 error mapping are absent.

features.title: Error objects
features.scope: A limited set of core Error constructors, message, name, errorID and toString.
features.limitations: General class construction, getStackTrace, complete prototype semantics and all Flash error codes are absent.

features.title: Classes, inheritance and interfaces
features.scope: One public AS3 class or interface per embedded source unit; constructors, public instance/static fields and get/set accessors, inherited property halves, super access, exact-signature project overrides and stable bound methods. Interfaces support multiple parents, exact public implementation checks, inherited implementations and nominal identity. Linked document/symbol classes initialize per active lifetime.
features.limitations: Private/protected/internal access, final/dynamic classes, native interfaces/overrides and full lazy static dependency ordering remain unsupported. Read-only/write-only violations use explicit runtime errors; the static type checker and typed assignment-expression result semantics are incomplete. This is a bounded useful class profile, not full AS3. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. The interfaces-accessors component scenario has bounded independent browser evidence; no full AVM2 conformance is claimed. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile.

features.title: Imports and project linking
features.scope: Optional packages, exact imports, same-package/qualified resolution, embedded source units and document/symbol linkage share a publication program. Unresolved/duplicate/cyclic types produce source-path diagnostics. Explicit library linkage IDs connect runtime creation to authored MovieClip symbols; exported linked classes must ultimately extend MovieClip. Interface units share exact import/type resolution, with cyclic and incompatible inherited contracts diagnosed.
features.limitations: Wildcard imports, SWC/bytecode libraries, filesystem/network module discovery and a general dependency toolchain are absent. Mixed-dialect imports and JS/TS project modules remain unsupported; AS2 classes have their separate profile. Independent ed3c39b evidence covers only the specified typed geometry/Timer workflow; other members and full timing/coercion remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. The interfaces-accessors ordinary-export/real-WASM component scenario and representative browser model updates/Restart passed; unobserved contract paths remain separate, and no full AVM2 conformance is claimed.

features.title: Dynamic objects and prototypes
features.scope: Object literals, custom fields, property/index reads and explicitly defined function members.
features.limitations: There is no complete Object/prototype/scope-chain model; computed calls, general alias/type inference and some dynamic methods are rejected.

features.title: Property enumeration and with
features.scope: for..in enumeration and correct name lookup inside with.
features.limitations: These are unsupported; a classic three-part for loop does not implement property enumeration.

features.title: Additional language operators
features.scope: new constructs resolved project classes, selected Error types and supported native value/event facades. Remaining is/as/instanceof/in/delete/unary void operators are still pending.
features.limitations: This does not implement all additional operators or arbitrary native construction; new native display placements are explicitly rejected.

features.title: Primitives and global conversions
features.scope: Number, Boolean, parseFloat, isNaN and isFinite retain JavaScript-backed conversions. String now uses the bounded primitive family facade; parseInt retains its separate pinned AS3 profile and earlier HTML5 acceptance.
features.limitations: Complete historical coercions, boxed values and the full standard library remain unfinished. Array/String expectations are documented_only; the combined browser pipeline passed without original Flash comparison.

features.title: Math
features.scope: A closed list of numeric Math methods, including trigonometry, abs, min/max, pow, random and round. Exact project imports also expose finite Point/Rectangle/Matrix values: point arithmetic, rectangle queries and affine matrix construction/composition/inversion/coordinate mapping. Display bounds and coordinate conversion use the same value classes.
features.limitations: Execution is delegated to JavaScript; the full contract and numerical equivalence with Flash are not certified. The shared geometry profile requires finite numbers and rejects overflow/singular inversion; Transform, 3D values and complete historical coercion/native-slot behavior remain pending. The combined geometry/Timer browser workflow and Restart passed.

features.title: Array, String and Number methods
features.scope: Bounded Array constructors and mutation/slicing, comparator/flag sort and multi-field sortOn; primitive String conversion, UTF-16 access/search/slicing/splitting/concatenation/casing. Shared adapters preserve custom overrides and lookup order in handlers and project methods. AS3 adds Array callbacks/search and literal-pattern String replacement. The earlier primitive toFixed adapter remains available.
features.limitations: Partial profiles: 1,000,000 array entries/string code units or results; ordinary records, restricted sortOn options, no native method extraction/prototype augmentation, RegExp/custom string patterns, locale operations or complete historical coercion/order. AS3 NUMERIC requires numeric values; AS2 boxed String is unsupported. See fixture profile constants for exact dialect limits. The combined collection/text browser scenario passed; this does not establish every method.

features.title: Trace through the browser host
features.scope: trace from handlers and nested functions runs through the host, updating the console and player status line.
features.limitations: This implements the observable NeoFlash output channel; complete formatting of all Flash types is not claimed.

features.title: MovieClip and timelines
features.scope: Void play/stop/gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop/nextFrame/prevFrame, current/total frames, named children and independent nested clocks. Linked authored classes initialize per active placement lifetime. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; new on the linked MovieClip class allocates its authored library timeline.
features.limitations: Full construction/re-entry/scenes, unrestricted authored-list mutation and original Flash lifecycle order remain unverified. Linked child-before-container initialization is the current bounded host contract. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile.

features.title: Display properties
features.scope: Position, alpha, scale, bounded finite rotation readback, visibility, names, root/parent/stage, child traversal, transformed bounds and coordinates, and supported nonrotated width/height writes. Native Sprite/Shape/MovieClip and project subclasses allocate stable runtime objects; containers add/remove/reparent/reorder dynamic children in an ordered suffix after authored children. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; new on the linked MovieClip class allocates its authored library timeline. Bitmap is a noncontainer display view over shared BitmapData with smoothing and pixel-snapping controls.
features.limitations: General authored/dynamic display mixing, masks/filters, full text layout and all owner-specific native APIs remain incomplete. Rotated dimension setters and singular coordinate conversions diagnose. Representative family behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; this is not full API or cross-engine acceptance. Independent ed3c39b evidence covers only the specified typed geometry/Timer workflow; other members and full timing/coercion remain unverified. Authored children cannot be moved/removed; detached runtime objects remain allocated until Restart, with a 4,096-object bound. General Flash depth replacement and full linked construction order remain unsupported. The combined dynamic-display browser workflow and Restart passed. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile. The bitmap-pixels family passes separate ordinary-export/real-WASM and in-app-browser checks for visible shared edits, source/clone independence, AS2 attachment and Restart. Native image-panel acceptance remains pending; full rasterization and coercion parity are not established.

features.title: Events and handlers
features.scope: Shared EventDispatcher add/remove/has/willTrigger/dispatch with capture/target/bubble, priorities, phase snapshots, cancellation and redispatch cloning. Event/MouseEvent/KeyboardEvent facades, Stage dimensions/frameRate/focus and bounded pointer/keyboard input share placement lifetimes. Imported Timer/TimerEvent add start/stop/reset, delay/repeatCount/currentCount/running, TIMER then TIMER_COMPLETE, listener dispatch and updateAfterEvent. Imported getTimer reads elapsed session milliseconds; Restart cancels old timers/listeners and rebases the clock.
features.limitations: Aggregation targets, full lifecycle/broadcast ordering, AS3 GC equivalence, fullscreen/scale modes, IME/touch and complete focus/input behavior remain pending. Exposed constants do not imply automatic lifecycle events; current fitted export has fixed logical Stage dimensions. Representative Stage behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; native Sources and broader input acceptance remain pending. Independent frozen-01f1381 browser verification found trusted mouse click events with isPrimary=false dropped by the shared Stage guard; semantic Enter and keyboard paths passed. The corrected input route passed coordinate clicks and Restart in the original class/Stage examples; an unlocated aggregate observer exception remains open. Timers accept finite bounded delays/repeat counts, schedule at least 1 ms and allow 1,024 concurrent runs by default. Browser throttling/catch-up, historical coercion/error IDs, public interval/timeout facades and full native inheritance remain outside this profile; the combined geometry/Timer browser workflow and Restart passed. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. Independent ed3c39b evidence covers only the specified typed geometry/Timer workflow; other members and full timing/coercion remain unverified.

features.title: Programmatic drawing
features.scope: Runtime-created Sprite/Shape/MovieClip graphics provide solid fills, positive round strokes, lines/quadratic paths, rectangles, ellipses/circles and clear. Exact Graphics imports type the owner-supplied facade; direct construction/inheritance reject.
features.limitations: Authored-owner drawing, hairlines, gradients, bitmap fills, non-round stroke modes, masks/filters and full legacy paint semantics remain unsupported. Graphics state is runtime-only and bounded to 100,000 commands/runs; the combined pointer/keyboard/dynamic-display workflow and Restart passed in the in-app browser. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified.

features.title: TextField and text APIs
features.scope: Existing authored Text elements now have live text/textColor, UTF-16 length, append/replace, line queries and partial Canvas text metrics through the shared runtime. Overrides leave authored content unchanged and clear with placement removal/replacement or Restart.
features.limitations: Plain string values and RGB integers only; 1 MiB UTF-8 text and bounded UTF-16 replacement ranges preserving complete characters. No rich formatting/HTML, wrapping, input/selection, embedded fonts or dynamic TextField creation. Canvas width and 1.2×font-size line height are not full Flash layout. Shared helpers do not establish every historical AS2 method. The combined collection/text browser scenario passed; this does not establish every method.

features.title: Audio, video and resource loading
features.scope: Authored embedded PNG/JPEG image placements use shared Rust decoding. BitmapData supports construction, pixel reads/writes, fillRect/copyPixels, clone/scroll and disposal over the shared pixel arena. AS3 Bitmap views share/replace bitmapData and expose smoothing plus PixelSnapping auto/always/never constants.
features.limitations: Audio/video, general Loader/image networking, BitmapData.loadBitmap linkage, draw/filter/shader/encode, bitmap fills, alpha masks, lock/unlock and native Bitmap/BitmapData subclasses remain unsupported. Pixel adapters require integer coordinates/uint colors; historical error/coercion/rasterization fidelity is not claimed. The combined bitmap-pixels ordinary-export/real-WASM scenario passes original PNG decoding, shared/independent buffers, both dialects, actual RGBA uploads, smoothing/snapping, disposal and Restart. The in-app-browser workflow visibly passed shared edits, source/clone independence, AS2 attachment and Restart; native image-panel interaction remains pending. Dimensions are bounded to 4096 per side, 256 buffer records per publication and 128 MiB live pixels; disposal releases bytes but keeps its record until Restart. Native PNG/JPEG placement is implemented with UI acceptance pending; other resource formats remain storage only.

features.title: Networking, storage and external communication
features.scope: Exact AS3 URLRequest/Header/Method, URLVariables, URLLoader/DataFormat and Progress/IOError/HTTPStatus event imports. GET/POST text/form/binary requests, asynchronous text/variables/ByteArray results, byte counters and current-operation events. Embedded version-3 project resources resolve offline; external HTTP(S) uses browser fetch/CORS. Cancellation and publication reset suppress obsolete work.
features.limitations: Bounded UTF-8/form profile and browser transport semantics, not complete Flash networking/security/error conformance. Native subclasses, filesystem loading, multipart/file uploads, sockets, URLStream, AMF/SharedObject, automatic retry/timeout policy and browser-navigation LoadVars.send remain unsupported. Limits: 16 MiB body/response, 64 MiB active response bytes, 32 concurrent operations, 1024 form pairs and 64 request headers. One combined ordinary-export/real-WASM resource-loading scenario passed embedded data, emitted AS3/AS2 HTTP POST through actual local fetch, cancellation and Restart. The embedded pipeline, same-origin HTTP GET and Restart passed in the in-app browser. Native resource-panel and direct-file browser opening remain pending; cross-origin browser CORS was not separately exercised. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified.

features.title: Components and platform libraries
features.scope: Flash/Flex components and applicable AIR/platform APIs, with separate browser adaptations.
features.limitations: These libraries are not implemented; porting platform APIs requires an explicit supported/adapted/unavailable contract.

features.title: Complete virtual-machine semantics
features.scope: AVM2 compatibility, including types, classes, coercion and runtime errors.
features.limitations: The current frontend emits JavaScript; internal regression tests are not Flash Player conformance certification.

features.title: Debugger and source maps
features.scope: ActionScript debugging with original source lines, breakpoints and state inspection.
features.limitations: Compile/publish diagnostics exist; a complete source debugger is absent.

features.title: Labels and named jumps
features.scope: Statement labels, labelled break and continue to outer loops, with function-boundary validation.
features.limitations: This status covers AS3 source control flow, not MovieClip frame labels.

features.title: Namespaces, XML and E4X
features.scope: namespace/use namespace, qualified names, XML/XMLList, E4X and for each.
features.limitations: These are rejected by the frontend; XFL XML parsing does not implement AS3 XML.

features.title: Vector, Dictionary and ByteArray
features.scope: AS3 exact ByteArray/Endian imports, indexed binary storage, primitive numeric IO, endian control, UTF, byte copying and clear. Publication-owned limits and reset/disposal isolate buffers; invalid size/overrun/UTF failures preserve state.
features.limitations: Ordinary JavaScript arrays and objects do not replace these contracts. Vector and Dictionary remain unimplemented. ByteArray excludes AMF, compression, other code pages, indexed enumeration, native subclass initialization and full coercion/error-class fidelity. Defaults bound each buffer to 16 MiB, total backing capacity to 64 MiB and initialized arrays to 4,096; the ordinary binary-data browser workflow and Restart passed. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified.
